text: `shell_completions.go` provides flag annotations used by shell completion. For example, `MarkFlagRequired` sets `BashCompOneRequiredFlag` to `"true"` (`shell_completions.go:35-40`), while `MarkFlagFilename` and `MarkPersistentFlagFilename` restrict completion to specified file extensions on local and persistent flag sets respectively (`shell_completions.go:42-46,58-63`).
